## Structure (verified by querying sqlite_master)

| group | items table | reviews table | extra | dominant / root category |
|-------|-------------|---------------|-------|--------------------------|
| g1 | items_g1 | fdbk_g1 | taxn_g1, attrs_g1, fdbk_stats_g1 | Office Products (`taxn_g1` root, 17,825 rows) |
